V-02.wrong: The rudimentary rules are easy to learn.
V-02.right: The basic rules are easy to learn.
V-02.diag: 高频词是文本的骨架：前 2000 词族覆盖日常文本约八成词次。rudimentary 和 basic 意思相近，但 basic 是高频劳模词，rudimentary 是低频书面词；在日常句子里用生僻词代替劳模词，句子立刻变拗口。
V-02.diag_kid: basic 是天天见面的老朋友，rudimentary 是很少出门的大词。跟朋友说话，用老朋友的名字，大家一下子就懂了。

V-03.diag: shortcomings 看着像 short + comings，但它是个整体词，意思是缺点；按零件猜意思，正好猜反——Laufer (1997) 记录的学生真把 shortcomings 理解成 short visits（短短的来访）。
V-03.diag_kid: shortcomings 不能拆开猜，拆开就猜错啦。它整个儿的意思是“缺点”，不是“短短的来访”。

V-03.wrong: The outline means the line is out of place.
V-03.right: An outline is a general plan or summary.
V-03.diag: outline 看着像 out + line，但它是个整体词，意思是提纲、大纲；Bensoussan & Laufer (1984) 记录学生把它理解成 out of line（出格了）。
V-03.diag_kid: outline 也不能拆开猜。它整个儿的意思是“提纲”，不是“线跑出去了”。

V-06.wrong: I made a photo of my family.
V-06.right: I took a photo of my family.
V-06.diag: photo 的搭档是 take，不是 make：take a photo 是整块存进脑子的语块。只记了 photo 的意思、没记它的搭档，提取时就会按汉语“拍”字面拼出 make a photo。
V-06.src: Yan (2010)，English Language Teaching Vol. 3 No. 1（ERIC EJ1081497）
V-06.diag_kid: 拍照要说 take a photo，take 和 photo 是一对好朋友，拆开就错啦。
V-06.source: Yan (2010)，English Language Teaching Vol. 3 No. 1（ERIC EJ1081497）

V-06.wrong: It was a big rain yesterday.
V-06.right: It was a heavy rain yesterday.
V-06.diag: 雨大不说 big rain，说 heavy rain：heavy 和 rain 是固定搭档。big 是汉语“大”的直译，英语里雨的“大”要说 heavy。
V-06.src: ICIHCS 2025 会议论文《中国大学生英语口语词汇选择错误研究》
V-06.diag_kid: 雨下得大，英语说 heavy rain，不说 big rain。heavy 才是 rain 的好朋友。
V-06.source: ICIHCS 2025 会议论文《中国大学生英语口语词汇选择错误研究》

V-08.wrong: POSH stands for 'Port Out, Starboard Home'.
V-08.right: POSH is not an acronym at all; its origin is unknown.
V-08.diag: POSH 不是 Port Out, Starboard Home 的缩写：现存船票上从没发现过 POSH 戳记，词源其实不明。把编出来的故事当真来历，就是民间词源的坑。
V-08.diag_kid: POSH 不是几个词的首字母拼起来的，它的老家是哪儿，没人知道。别信编出来的小故事哦。

V-09.wrong: We should learn knowledge from books.
V-09.right: We should acquire knowledge from books.
V-09.diag: knowledge 不和 learn 搭，和 acquire/gain 搭：learn knowledge 是把汉语“学习知识”逐字搬过来。投入量要花在真搭配上，不是花在直译上。
V-09.src: ICIHCS 2025 会议论文《中国大学生英语口语词汇选择错误研究》
V-09.diag_kid: 知识不能 learn knowledge，要说 acquire knowledge。learn 和 knowledge 不是一对儿。
V-09.source: ICIHCS 2025 会议论文《中国大学生英语口语词汇选择错误研究》

V-09.diag: discuss 是及物动词，后面直接跟东西，不加 about：discuss about it 是把汉语“讨论关于”的结构搬了过来。
V-09.diag_kid: discuss 后面直接跟要讨论的东西，不用加 about。discuss the plan 就够啦。

V-11.wrong: Please pay attention on the blackboard.
V-11.right: Please pay attention to the blackboard.
V-11.diag: pay attention to 是整块存的语块，to 是它身上的一块零件；只提取出 pay attention、丢了 to，句子就缺了一块。
V-11.diag_kid: pay attention to 是一整个，不能丢掉最后的 to。就像拼图少了一块，图就不完整啦。

V-13.wrong: Can you borrow me a pencil?
V-13.right: Can you lend me a pencil?
V-13.diag: borrow 和 lend 是同一幕买卖戏里的两个角色：borrow 是借进来，lend 是借出去。问别人借铅笔，要站在“借出去”的角色上说 lend。
V-13.src: ChineseTrack《Common Errors That Chinese Speakers Make in English》
V-13.diag_kid: borrow 是“借进来”，lend 是“借出去”。问别人借铅笔，要说 lend me，别说 borrow me。
V-13.source: ChineseTrack《Common Errors That Chinese Speakers Make in English》

V-13.wrong: The price of this phone is very expensive.
V-13.right: The price of this phone is very high.
V-13.diag: price 是“价格”，expensive 是形容东西贵的；价格本身贵，要说 high。The price is expensive 是把 expensive 的主语从东西错安到了价格上。
V-13.src: ICIHCS 2025 会议论文《中国大学生英语口语词汇选择错误研究》
V-13.diag_kid: 东西贵说 expensive，价格高说 high。The price is high，别说 The price is expensive。
V-13.source: ICIHCS 2025 会议论文《中国大学生英语口语词汇选择错误研究》

V-14.wrong: The PRIZE of this phone is very high.
V-14.right: The PRICE of this phone is very high.
V-14.diag: price 是价格，prize 是奖品：两个词长得像、读音也近，但意思各管一摊。手机的价格高，要说 price。
V-14.src: 英语教学短视频（Shashikant English Trainer）
V-14.diag_kid: price 是价格，prize 是奖品。两个词长得很像，可别认错啦。
V-14.source: 英语教学短视频（Shashikant English Trainer）

V-14.wrong: I won a price in the contest.
V-14.right: I won a prize in the contest.
V-14.diag: 比赛里赢到的是 prize（奖品），不是 price（价格）。
V-14.diag_kid: 比赛赢到的是 prize，是奖品，不是 price 价格。

V-17.diag: very 只能修饰形容词和副词，不能修饰动词 like；喜欢得不得了要说 really like。错句暴露的是缺口：very 的用法边界还没被输出照亮。
V-17.src: Deen Cox IELTS 简报（Chinglish 常见错误）
V-17.diag_kid: very 不能放在 like 前面，要说 really like。very 是形容词的好朋友，不是动词的。
V-17.source: Deen Cox IELTS 简报（Chinglish 常见错误）

V-17.diag: agree 是动词，“我同意”直接说 I agree，不加 am；加了 am 就把它当成了形容词。输出时现了原形，才知道 agree 的词类没存对。
V-17.diag_kid: agree 是动词，直接说 I agree，不用加 am。am 是留给形容词的。

V-19.wrong: The teacher interrogated me about my homework.
V-19.right: The teacher asked me about my homework.
V-19.diag: ask 是本族词，interrogate 是法语—拉丁层的大词，只用在警察、法庭那种正式盘问的场合。问作业用 interrogate，是把高层词错放进了日常场合。
V-19.src: Merriam-Webster 词源科普帖（诺曼征服与双层词汇）
V-19.diag_kid: 问作业说 ask 就好啦。interrogate 是警察叔叔盘问时才用的大词，平时不用它。
V-19.source: Merriam-Webster 词源科普帖（诺曼征服与双层词汇）

V-20.wrong: It is unpossible to finish in one day.
V-20.right: It is impossible to finish in one day.
V-20.diag: un- 不是万能钥匙：possible 的反义词是 impossible，im- 才是它的零件。造词机器要认零件，不是随便拼。
V-20.diag_kid: possible 的反义词是 impossible，不是 unpossible。un- 不能什么词都往上贴。

V-20.wrong: There are three childs in the room.
V-20.right: There are three children in the room.
V-20.diag: child 的复数不是加 -s，而是换成 children：不规则复数是整词存的，不能按规则机器现造。
V-20.diag_kid: child 的复数是 children，不是 childs。这个要整个儿记住，不能加 -s。

V-24.wrong: A hamburger is made of ham.
V-24.right: A hamburger is made of beef; it is named after the city of Hamburg.
V-24.diag: hamburger 的 ham 不是火腿：它得名于德国城市 Hamburg，夹的是牛肉饼。后人按 ham + burger 重新切分，是民间词源再分析。
V-24.src: Mental Floss《Why Is It Called a Hamburger?》
V-24.diag_kid: 汉堡包里没有火腿，它的名字来自德国的汉堡市，里面夹的是牛肉饼。
V-24.source: Mental Floss《Why Is It Called a Hamburger?》

V-24.wrong: A crayfish is a kind of fish.
V-24.right: A crayfish is a small crustacean, like a tiny lobster; its name comes from Old French crevis, not from fish.
V-24.diag: crayfish 不是鱼：它来自古法语 crevice（小螃蟹），后半截被听成 fish 才改了拼写；它其实是甲壳动物，像小龙虾。
V-24.diag_kid: crayfish 不是鱼，它是像小龙虾一样的小动物。它的名字是从 crevice 变来的，不是 fish 变来的。

V-24.wrong: A bridegroom is a man who grooms the bride.
V-24.right: A bridegroom is simply the bride's man; 'groom' replaced Old English guma, meaning 'man'.
V-24.diag: bridegroom 里没有 groom（照料马的人）：古英语是 brydguma，guma 是“男人”的意思；guma 失传后，人们按熟悉的 groom 重新拼了这个词。
V-24.diag_kid: bridegroom 不是“给新娘梳毛的人”，它原来的意思是“新娘的男人”。groom 是后来拼错拼进去的。

V-27.wrong: There are people mountain people sea in the street.
V-27.right: There is a huge crowd of people in the street.
V-27.diag: 人山人海是汉语的整块说法，逐字搬成 people mountain people sea，英语里没有这块；要说 a huge crowd of people。
V-27.src: Theory and Practice in Language Studies Vol. 5 No. 6 (2015)《Types of Chinese Negative Transfer to English》
V-27.diag_kid: 人山人海不能一个词一个词翻成英语，英语说 a huge crowd of people，就是“好大一群人”。
V-27.source: Theory and Practice in Language Studies Vol. 5 No. 6 (2015)《Types of Chinese Negative Transfer to English》

V-27.wrong: I have a free time this afternoon.
V-27.diag: 汉语“我有空”逐字搬成 I have a free time：free time 在英语里不这样数，要说 I'm free。
V-27.src: Theory and Practice in Language Studies Vol. 5 No. 6 (2015)《Types of Chinese Negative Transfer to English》
V-27.diag_kid: “我有空”说 I'm free，别说 I have a free time。
V-27.source: Theory and Practice in Language Studies Vol. 5 No. 6 (2015)《Types of Chinese Negative Transfer to English》

V-28.diag: go 的过去式是 went，不是按规则加 -ed 造出来的 goed：不规则动词是整词存的，规则机器套不上去。Leopold (1939–1949) 记录儿童真的说过 goed。
V-28.diag_kid: go 的过去式是 went，不是 goed。这个要整个儿记住。

V-28.wrong: My foots hurt after the long walk.
V-28.right: My feet hurt after the long walk.
V-28.diag: foot 的复数是 feet，不是按规则加 -s 造出来的 foots：和 goed 一样，是规则过度泛化，Leopold 也记录过。
V-28.diag_kid: foot 的复数是 feet，不是 foots。这个也要整个儿记住。

V-29.wrong: Her happyness made us all smile.
V-29.right: Her happiness made us all smile.
V-29.diag: happy 加 -ness 要先把 y 变成 i：happiness。直接拼 happyness，是没看见派生词里的 y→i 变身规则。
V-29.diag_kid: happy 加 -ness 的时候，y 要变成 i，写成 happiness。y 不变身，就拼错啦。

V-30.wrong: It is dispossible to do that.
V-30.right: It is impossible to do that.
V-30.diag: dis- 不是 possible 的零件：possible 的反义词是 impossible。光认得前缀的样子、不认它配哪个词根，就会拼出 dispossible。
V-30.diag_kid: possible 的反义词是 impossible，不是 dispossible。前缀也要认对搭档。

V-30.wrong: Don't be unpatient with the little kids.
V-30.right: Don't be impatient with the little kids.
V-30.diag: patient 的反义词是 impatient，不是 unpatient：un-、im-、dis- 各有各的搭档，认错搭档就造出假词。
V-30.src: RSD Journal (2025)《Common errors in the use of prefixes and suffixes by language learners》
V-30.diag_kid: patient 的反义词是 impatient，不是 unpatient。im- 才是 patient 的搭档。
V-30.source: RSD Journal (2025)《Common errors in the use of prefixes and suffixes by language learners》

V-41.wrong: He went to the bank to take out money.（但上下文是去河边钓鱼）
V-41.right: He went to the river bank to fish.
V-41.diag: bank 有两个家：银行和河岸。只认得“银行”那一义，读到河边的 bank 也会往钱上想。Fromkin 等人 (2011) 用 He went to the bank 说明：不看上下文，多义词就会猜错。本条是理解性误读病例，不是产出性错句。
V-41.src: Scientific Journal of Faculty of Education, Misurata University《Lexical and Structural Ambiguity in English》，引 Fromkin et al. (2011)
V-41.diag_kid: bank 不光是银行，还是河岸。读故事的时候要看看周围的词，别一看到 bank 就想到钱。
V-41.source: Scientific Journal of Faculty of Education, Misurata University《Lexical and Structural Ambiguity in English》，引 Fromkin et al. (2011)

V-42.wrong: We made a meeting to discuss the new product.
V-42.right: Let's hold a meeting to discuss the new product.
V-42.diag: 开会不说 make a meeting、do a meeting，说 hold a meeting：hold 是 meeting 的固定搭档。make/do 是按汉语“开”字面拼出来的。
V-42.diag_kid: 开会说 hold a meeting，不说 make a meeting。hold 才是 meeting 的好朋友。

V-42.wrong: We will do a meeting tomorrow.
V-42.right: We will hold a meeting tomorrow.
V-42.diag: 同上：do a meeting 是按汉语“做/开会”直译，英语里会议的动词是 hold。
V-42.diag_kid: 开会说 hold a meeting，不说 do a meeting。

V-45.wrong: My money ran when I got to Cornwall out.
V-45.right: My money ran out when I got to Cornwall.
V-45.diag: run 不光是“跑”：run out of 是“用完了”，整块的意思和跑没关系。只认得 run 的核心义“跑”，就读不懂 My money ran out，连粒子该放哪儿都不知道。
V-45.diag_kid: run 不光是跑，run out of 是“用完了”。My money ran out 是说“我的钱花光了”。

CO-01.wrong: He suggested me a good book.
CO-01.right: He suggested a good book to me.
CO-01.diag: suggest 不进双宾模具：“建议某人某物”要说 suggest something to somebody，不能说 suggest somebody something。模具本身带意思，不是所有动词都能进。
CO-01.diag_kid: suggest 不能说 suggest me a book，要说 suggest a book to me。不是所有动词都能走“给某人某物”这条路。

CO-02.wrong: John donated the charity the money.
CO-02.right: John donated the money to the charity.
CO-02.diag: donate 也不进双宾模具：捐钱给慈善机构要说 donate the money to the charity。donate 是拉丁层的大词，拒绝双宾模具。
CO-02.src: Lee, Ki Taek (HUFS)《A Reanalysis of Double Object Constructions and Dative Constructions in English》
CO-02.diag_kid: donate 不能说 donate the charity the money，要说 donate the money to the charity。
CO-02.source: Lee, Ki Taek (HUFS)《A Reanalysis of Double Object Constructions and Dative Constructions in English》

CO-05.diag: make + 人 + 形容词是结果模具：You make me happy，happy 是结果，中间不用加 be。加了 be，就把结果句拆成了两截。
CO-05.src: WordReference 论坛帖（学习者原句提问）
CO-05.diag_kid: You make me happy 中间不用加 be，happy 直接跟在 me 后面，就是“让我变开心”的结果。
CO-05.source: WordReference 论坛帖（学习者原句提问）

CO-06.wrong: The boss promised to me a raise.
CO-06.right: The boss promised me a raise.
CO-06.type: 双宾模具意思家族混淆
CO-06.diag: promise 是“打算给”家族的：答应给某人加薪，说 promise somebody something，to 是多余的——promise me a raise，不是 promise to me a raise。
CO-06.src: UsingEnglish 论坛帖（promise somebody / to somebody 讨论）
CO-06.diag_kid: 答应给某人东西，说 promise me a raise，中间不用加 to。
CO-06.source: UsingEnglish 论坛帖（promise somebody / to somebody 讨论）

CO-06.type: 双宾模具意思家族混淆
CO-06.diag: promise 后面跟动作，要用 to + 动词：I promised to help him。直接跟 help，是把 promise 当成了 let/make 那类动词。
CO-06.src: Facebook 教学帖（A+ English，学习者错句批改）
CO-06.diag_kid: 答应帮别人做事，要说 I promised to help him，help 前面要加 to。
CO-06.source: Facebook 教学帖（A+ English，学习者错句批改）

CO-08.wrong: The accident was happened when the car went off the road.
CO-08.right: The accident happened when the car went off the road.
CO-08.diag: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动式：The accident happened，不能说 was happened。把不及物动词硬套被动，是过度泛化。
CO-08.src: Fisher (2005)《English Writing Suggestions for Chinese-Speaking Students》，York University
CO-08.diag_kid: happen 没有被动式，说 The accident happened，别说 was happened。
CO-08.source: Fisher (2005)《English Writing Suggestions for Chinese-Speaking Students》，York University

CO-08.wrong: I was graduated from Zhongshan University.
CO-08.diag: graduate 也是不及物动词：I graduated from Zhongshan University，不能说 was graduated。CLEC 语料里中国学生真这样写过。
CO-08.src: CLEC 学习者语料（ST5），转引自 SlideServe《How can corpora help in language pedagogy?》
CO-08.diag_kid: 毕业说 I graduated，别说 I was graduated。
CO-08.source: CLEC 学习者语料（ST5），转引自 SlideServe《How can corpora help in language pedagogy?》

CO-09.diag: develop 在这里是中动：主语是承受者，但动词用主动式，Science develops quickly。写成 is developed，是把中动错当成了被动。CLEC 语料 ST4 真有这句。
CO-09.src: CLEC 学习者语料（ST4），转引自 SlideServe《How can corpora help in language pedagogy?》
CO-09.diag_kid: 科学自己在发展，说 Science develops quickly，别说 is developed。
CO-09.source: CLEC 学习者语料（ST4），转引自 SlideServe《How can corpora help in language pedagogy?》

CO-09.diag: English developed from Latin 是中动句：语言自己演变，不用被动。香港大学 Telenex 把 English was developed from Latin 列为学生的常见错误。
CO-09.src: 香港大学 Telenex《Using passive voice (Students' problems)》
CO-09.diag_kid: 英语是从拉丁语演变来的，说 English developed from Latin，别说 was developed。
CO-09.source: 香港大学 Telenex《Using passive voice (Students' problems)》

CO-10.diag: Me want cookie 是动词岛阶段的句子：孩子把 want 当成一个固定岛，me 是岛上自带的主语，还没泛化出 I + 动词的通用主格。Rispoli (2018) 记录儿童在 me want 和 I want 之间摇摆。
CO-10.diag_kid: 小朋友说 Me want cookie，是把 want 当成一座小岛，岛上住着 me。长大一点就知道，主语是“我”的时候要说 I want。

CO-12.wrong: — How do you do? — I'm fine, thank you.
CO-12.right: — How do you do? — How do you do.
CO-12.diag: How do you do? 是见面套语，不是真的在问“你好吗”：回答还是 How do you do?，不是 I'm fine, thank you。把套语当成活问句，就会答错。
CO-12.src: Vedantu《What do you do / How do you do》
CO-12.diag_kid: How do you do? 是见面打招呼的固定说法，回答还是 How do you do?，不是 I'm fine。
CO-12.source: Vedantu《What do you do / How do you do》

CO-12.wrong: How do you do?（见到同学，随口打招呼用）
CO-12.diag: How do you do? 只用在第一次见面的正式场合；跟同学随口打招呼，说 Hi! How are you?。对谁都说 How do you do?，是把套语用错了场合。
CO-12.diag_kid: How do you do? 是第一次见面很正式的时候才说的，跟同学打招呼说 Hi! How are you?

CO-14.diag: enjoy 点名要 -ing：I enjoy swimming。enjoy to swim 是把 enjoy 当成了 want 那类点名 to 的动词。
CO-14.diag_kid: enjoy 后面要跟 swimming，不能跟 to swim。每个动词点的名都不一样，enjoy 点的是 -ing。

CO-14.wrong: I look forward to see you.
CO-14.right: I look forward to seeing you.
CO-14.diag: look forward to 后面的 to 是介词，介词后面跟 -ing：I look forward to seeing you。把 to 当成不定式符号，就会写成 to see。
CO-14.diag_kid: look forward to 里面的 to 是介词，后面要跟 seeing。to see 是错的哦。

CO-15.wrong: Because John was ill, so I took him to the doctor.
CO-15.right: Because John was ill, I took him to the doctor.
CO-15.diag: 英语里 because 和 so 不能同时出现：Because John was ill, I took him to the doctor。两个都写，是把汉语“因为……所以……”的双份结构搬了过来。
CO-15.src: 中考英语复习资料（360doc 转载）
CO-15.diag_kid: 英语里 because 和 so 不能一起出现，有了 because，就不要 so 啦。
CO-15.source: 中考英语复习资料（360doc 转载）

CO-15.wrong: Although he is over sixty, but he works as hard as others.
CO-15.right: Although he is over sixty, he works as hard as others.
CO-15.diag: although 和 but 也不能同时出现：Although he is over sixty, he works as hard as others。双份连词是汉语结构的迁移。
CO-15.src: 中考英语复习资料（360doc 转载）
CO-15.diag_kid: although 和 but 也不能一起出现，有了 although，就不要 but 啦。
CO-15.source: 中考英语复习资料（360doc 转载）

CO-17.wrong: I did a mistake in the test.
CO-17.right: I made a mistake in the test.
CO-17.diag: 犯错说 make a mistake：make 是空心动词，真正的意思在 mistake 这个名词里。do a mistake 是按汉语“做”字面拼的。
CO-17.src: FP Formazione 词汇讲义《Vocabulary, Word Building & Writing Skills》
CO-17.diag_kid: 犯错说 make a mistake，别说 do a mistake。make 和 mistake 是一对儿。
CO-17.source: FP Formazione 词汇讲义《Vocabulary, Word Building & Writing Skills》

CO-17.wrong: He did a gesture to say hello.
CO-17.right: He made a gesture to say hello.
CO-17.diag: 做手势说 make a gesture：gesture 的空心动词搭档是 make，不是 do。Yan (2010) 记录学生真写过 do a gesture。
CO-17.src: Yan (2010)，English Language Teaching Vol. 3 No. 1（ERIC EJ1081497）
CO-17.diag_kid: 做手势说 make a gesture，别说 do a gesture。
CO-17.source: Yan (2010)，English Language Teaching Vol. 3 No. 1（ERIC EJ1081497）

QI-01.wrong: What colour do you like, red or blue?
QI-01.right: Which colour do you like, red or blue?
QI-01.diag: what 问的是开放的一大片，which 问的是给出的几个选项里挑一个：red or blue 已经把选项摆出来了，要用 which。
QI-01.diag_kid: 有两个颜色让你挑，要用 which，不用 what。which 是“挑一个”的意思。

QI-03.diag: Who's 是 who is 的缩写，whose 才是“谁的”：问包是谁的，要说 Whose bag is this?
QI-03.src: Vedantu《How to Use Whose and Who's》
QI-03.diag_kid: 问“这是谁的包”，要说 Whose bag is this? Who's 是“谁是”的意思，别弄混啦。
QI-03.source: Vedantu《How to Use Whose and Who's》

QI-03.diag: 反过来也一样：问“谁要去演讲”，who's（who is）才对；Whose going 是错的，whose 后面要跟东西。
QI-03.src: Vedantu《How to Use Whose and Who's》
QI-03.diag_kid: 问“谁要去”，要说 Who's going。whose 后面要跟东西，不能跟 going。
QI-03.source: Vedantu《How to Use Whose and Who's》

QI-05.wrong: I like coffee, not tea.（说得平平的，哪个词都没加重）
QI-05.diag: 纠正别人的话，要把重音落在被纠正的词上：I like COFFEE, not tea。说得平平的、哪个词都不加重，听的人就不知道你到底在纠正哪一个。
QI-05.diag_kid: 说“我喜欢咖啡，不是茶”，要把咖啡说得重重的，别人一下子就知道你在纠正他啦。

QI-06.wrong: I by bus go to school.
QI-06.right: I go to school by bus.
QI-06.diag: 状语排队有个倾向：方式—地点—时间，by bus 是方式，go to school 是动作，方式状语跟在动词后面：I go to school by bus。
QI-06.diag_kid: by bus 要跟在 go to school 后面，不能插到 I 和 go 中间。

QI-06.wrong: Yesterday I in the park walked.
QI-06.right: Yesterday I walked in the park.
QI-06.diag: 时间状语 Yesterday 放句首没问题，但地点状语 in the park 要跟在 walked 后面：Yesterday I walked in the park。
QI-06.diag_kid: Yesterday 放前面没问题，但 in the park 要跟在 walked 后面。

QI-07.diag: here/there 前置要倒装：Here comes the bus。按正常顺序说 Here the bus comes，是学了前置、忘了倒装。
QI-07.src: 新东方中考英语语法总结（XDF）
QI-07.diag_kid: Here 开头的句子，动词要跑到主语前面：Here comes the bus，别说 Here the bus comes。
QI-07.source: 新东方中考英语语法总结（XDF）

QI-07.diag: 同上：Here lies the book，动词 lies 在主语 the book 前面。
QI-07.diag_kid: Here lies the book，lies 跑到 the book 前面去啦。

QI-08.wrong: Would you like coffee or tea?（两个选项都用降调）
QI-08.right: Would you like coffee ↗ or tea ↘?
QI-08.diag: 二选一的问句，第一个选项升调、第二个降调：coffee ↗ or tea ↘。两个选项都降调，听着就像在陈述，不像在问。
QI-08.src: ICanRead《How can we help Simplified Chinese [learners]?》
QI-08.diag_kid: 问“要咖啡还是茶”，咖啡那里声音要往上扬，茶那里再落下来。这样别人才知道你在问他挑一个。
QI-08.source: ICanRead《How can we help Simplified Chinese [learners]?》

QI-08.wrong: Are you coming?（用降调说，听起来像陈述句）
QI-08.diag: 一般疑问句句尾要升调：Are you coming? ↗。用降调说，听起来就像一句话说完了，不是提问。汉语里疑问句也常用升降调，容易带偏。
QI-08.src: ICanRead《How can we help Simplified Chinese [learners]?》
QI-08.diag_kid: 问 Are you coming? 的时候，声音尾巴要往上扬。往下掉，就听着像在说一句话，不是问问题。
QI-08.source: ICanRead《How can we help Simplified Chinese [learners]?》

QI-09.wrong: She was late because the traffic.
QI-09.right: She was late because of the traffic.
QI-09.diag: because 后面跟句子，because of 后面跟名词：the traffic 是名词，要说 because of the traffic。
QI-09.diag_kid: because 后面跟一整句话，because of 后面跟一个东西。the traffic 是个东西，要说 because of。

QI-09.wrong: Ali got tired because of his shopping business did not take off.
QI-09.right: Ali got tired because his shopping business did not take off.
QI-09.diag: 反过来：his shopping business did not take off 是一整句话，前面要说 because，不能说 because of。
QI-09.src: BBC Learning English（Facebook 评论区批改实例）
QI-09.diag_kid: his shopping business did not take off 是一整句话，前面要说 because，不能说 because of。
QI-09.source: BBC Learning English（Facebook 评论区批改实例）

QI-12.wrong: — Don't you speak English? — Yes, I don't speak English.
QI-12.right: — Don't you speak English? — No, I don't speak English.
QI-12.diag: 英语回答否定问句跟事实走，不跟“同不同意对方”走：Don't you speak English? 事实是不会说，答 No, I don't。按汉语认同式答 Yes，是把汉语的回答系统搬了过来。
QI-12.diag_kid: 别人问“你不会说英语吗”，你确实不会，要答 No, I don't。别按汉语的习惯答 Yes。

QI-12.wrong: — Don't you like rice? — Yes, I don't like rice.
QI-12.right: — Don't you like rice? — No, I don't like rice.
QI-12.diag: 同上：不喜欢米饭，答 No, I don't like rice。
QI-12.diag_kid: 不喜欢米饭，就答 No, I don't like rice。Yes 是留给“喜欢”的时候的。

QI-14.diag: What your name? 是整句模仿级还没爬上倒装台阶：疑问句里 be 动词要倒装，What is your name?。Sohar 大学的研究记录学生真这样问。
QI-14.src: IJASOS Vol. XI Issue 33 (2025)《Question Formation Errors Among EFL Learners at Sohar》
QI-14.diag_kid: 问名字要说 What is your name?，中间的 is 不能丢。丢了 is，句子就站不起来啦。
QI-14.source: IJASOS Vol. XI Issue 33 (2025)《Question Formation Errors Among EFL Learners at Sohar》

QI-14.diag: Where you live? 也是同一级台阶的错：疑问句里动词前面要加 do，Where do you live?。
QI-14.diag_kid: 问住在哪儿要说 Where do you live?，do 不能丢。

QI-15.right: What did you read at home last night?
QI-15.diag: 举着书问 What is this?，答案大家都看得见，问了等于没问：提问要有真缺口。改成问昨天晚上读了什么，才是真问题。右边的改法是按 Long (1983) 的信息差原则换的问句，不是原句的逐字改正。
QI-15.src: Liao《Information Gap in Communicative Classrooms》，English Teaching Forum
QI-15.diag_kid: 举着书问“这是什么”，大家都看得见，就不用问啦。问点别人不知道的事，比如“你昨晚读了什么”，才有意思。
QI-15.source: Liao《Information Gap in Communicative Classrooms》，English Teaching Forum

QI-15.right: What did you dream about last night?
QI-15.diag: Do you sleep every day? 答案人人都知道是 yes，也是明知故问；换成问昨晚做了什么梦，才有真缺口。右边同样是信息差替换，不是逐字改正。
QI-15.src: Liao《Information Gap in Communicative Classrooms》，English Teaching Forum
QI-15.diag_kid: 问“你每天睡觉吗”，谁都知道答案是“睡呀”。换成“你昨晚做了什么梦”，才好玩。
QI-15.source: Liao《Information Gap in Communicative Classrooms》，English Teaching Forum
